    用自身優勢，自研自產的氧化物電解質材料、                             state battery technology. Leveraging its in-house strengths, its self-
    硫化物粉體材料均具有更高離子電導率和工                              developed and self-produced oxide electrolyte materials and sulfide powder
    程化能力；新一代混合固液鋰離子電池在大                              materials demonstrate higher ionic conductivity and enhanced engineering
    幅提升能量密度的同時，在多點針刺測試、                              capabilities. The new generation of hybrid solid-liquid lithium-ion batteries
    加熱測試中體現出更優異的安全性能；在續                              not only significantly improves energy density but also exhibits superior
    航方面，高比能電芯滿足長里程需求，在極                              safety performance in multi-point nail penetration tests and heating tests.
    低温寒冷條件下仍保持強勁動力。公司持續                              In terms of endurance, the high-specific-energy cells meet long-range
    推進固態鋰電池的研發、生產和商業化應用，                             requirements while maintaining strong power output even under extremely
    積極佈局和開發高能量密度、高功率的飛行                              cold conditions. The Company continues to advance the R&D, production,
    動力電芯與電源系統產品，以滿足不同領域                              and commercial application of solid-state lithium batteries, actively
    需求。                                              developing high-energy-density, high-power aviation power cells and power
                                                     system products to meet diverse industry demands.

    原料的多元化供應渠道，實現鋰、鎳、鈷、                              economic potential. It can also further enrich the diversified supplies of

                             CHAIRMAN’S STATEMENT

 2025年，贛鋒鋰業集團深入推行組織機構變革，確立
「先進材料、電池與回收、儲能」三大核心業務板塊，
 整合集團職能部門，打造適應集團戰略與未來產業發
 展的敏捷型組織體系。過去一年，各板塊、各部門在
 集團的統一領導及全體職工的努力奮鬥下，各項工作
 取得顯著成果。

2026年，企 業 的 發 展 壯 大 對 組 織 管 理 提 出 了 更 高 的
要求，企業需要增強組織凝聚力和戰鬥力，持續深化
薪酬體系改革，強化人才激勵與優化機制，把更多資
源優先集中到奮鬥者，大力弘揚奮鬥者文化，堅決杜
絕「躺平」思想，保障組織隊伍的戰鬥力。

In 2025, the Ganfeng Lithium Group thoroughly
implemented organizational restructuring, established
three core business sectors of “Advanced Materials,
Battery & Recycling, and Energy Storage”, integrated
group functional departments, and built an agile
organizational system aligned with the Group’s
strategy and the development of future industries. Over
the past year, under the unified leadership of the Group
and the joint efforts of all employees, all sectors and
departments have achieved remarkable results in their
work.

In 2026, the growth and expansion of the enterprise
place higher demands on organizational management.
The enterprise needs to enhance organizational
cohesion and combat effectiveness, continue to deepen
the reform of the compensation system, strengthen
talent incentives and optimization mechanisms, prioritize
the allocation of more resources to strivers, vigorously
promote the culture of strivers, resolutely put an end to
the ideology of “lying flat”, and safeguard the combat
effectiveness of the organizational team.

                                           MANAGEMENT DISCUSSION AND ANALYSIS

行業回顧                                 INDUSTRY REVIEW

1.   鋰資源市場分析                         1.   Analysis of lithium resource market

     全球鋰資源供給大部分來自鹽湖和硬                      The majority of global lithium resources are sourced from salars and
     岩 鋰 礦。成 熟 的 鹽 湖 主 要 分 佈 在 南 美         hard rock lithium mines. Well-developed salars are mainly found in
     鋰 三 角 和 中 國，大 部 份 鋰 礦 山 依 然 集         the lithium delta of South America and in China, while the majority

           European Commission     Carbon Emissions Assessment System          In April 2025, the European Commission proposed amendments to the
                                     Amendment                                    carbon emissions assessment system. The new regulations will change
                                                                                  the annual carbon emissions assessment for automakers to an average
                                                                                  assessment of carbon emissions over a three-year assessment period
                                                                                  (2025–2027), and will resume annual carbon emissions assessments after
                                                                                  2027. On 8 May 2025, the European Parliament and member negotiated
                                                                                  and reached an agreement on the proposed changes. The amendments
                                                                                  officially took effect by the end of 2025. The carbon emissions legislation
                                                                                  imposes significant compliance pressures on the supply side in the long
                                                                                  term.

                                   推遲《歐盟電池與廢電池法規》中經濟運                          2025年5月，歐盟委員會今日正式提交提案，擬將《歐盟電池與廢電池法
                                    營商電池供應鏈盡職調查義務                                 規》(Regulation (EU) 2023/1542）中關於經濟運營商電池供應鏈盡職調
                                                                                  查義務的實施時間推遲兩年，新生效日期定為2027年8月18日。歐盟
                                                                                  本計劃在8月實施的電池法案中的電池供應鏈盡職調查環節被延期兩
                                                                                  年，企業提交碳足跡報告也有延期，這意味著起碼兩年內中國鋰電池
                                                                                  企業出口歐洲依然暢通無阻。
                                   Postponement of due diligence obligations   In May 2025, the European Commission formally submitted a proposal
                                     for economic operators in the battery        to postpone the implementation of the due diligence obligations for
                                     supply chain under the EU Batteries and      economic operators in the battery supply chain under the EU Batteries
                                     Waste Batteries Regulation                   and Waste Batteries Regulation (Regulation (EU) 2023/1542) by two
                                                                                  years, with the new effective date set for 18 August 2027. The due
                                                                                  diligence requirements for the battery supply chain in the EU’s battery
                                                                                  legislation, which were originally scheduled to take effect in August,

                                                                                  submit carbon footprint reports has also been extended, which means
                                                                                  that Chinese lithium battery companies will continue to have unimpeded

                                                                     動車替代燃油車。該計劃獲歐盟批准，並納入國家復甦與韌性計劃
                                                                     (PNRR)第五次修訂中。此次新政策的目標是替換約3.9萬輛燃油車為

                                                                      歐元。
Italian Government   New policy for electric vehicle “trade-ins”   In June 2025, the Italian government announced the launch of a new green
                                                                      incentive program to encourage the replacement of gasoline-powered
                                                                      vehicles with electric vehicles. The program has been approved by the
                                                                      European Union and included in the fifth revision of the National Recovery
                                                                      and Resilience Plan (PNRR). The goal of this new policy is to replace
                                                                      approximately 39,000 gasoline-powered vehicles with electric vehicles.
                                                                      The government has allocated a budget of €600 million originally intended
                                                                      for the installation of charging stations. The funds must be fully utilized by
                                                                      30 June 2026.

                                                                   Subsidy criteria: ISEE (annual household income)

                                                                   Subsidy amount: Taxpayers with an ISEE of €30,000 or less
                                                                     are eligible for a subsidy of €11,000 for an electric vehicle;
                                                                     taxpayers with an ISEE between €30,000 and €40,000 receive
                                                                     a subsidy of €9,000.

                                       Energy Transition Act           Energy storage projects will be compensated based on

     8.    固態電池市場分析                                   8.   Analysis of the solid-state battery market

           固 態 電 池 是 一 種 新 型 儲 能 技 術，其 工                   Solid-state batteries are a new type of energy storage technology,
           作 原 理 與 液 態 鋰 離 子 電 池 相 似。固 態                   with operating principles similar to liquid lithium-ion batteries. The main
           鋰離子電池的主要材料包括正極材料、                               materials of solid-state lithium-ion batteries include cathode materials,
           負 極 材 料 和 固 態 電 解 質 等，其 核 心 在                   anode materials and solid electrolytes. The core of this technology
           於將液態電池的電解液與隔膜替換成                                lies in replacing the electrolyte solutions and diaphragms of liquid
           固 態 電 解 質，實 現 不 用 或 者 少 用 隔 膜                   batteries with solid electrolytes, reducing or eliminating the need
           及 電 解 液，相 較 於 傳 統 鋰 離 子 電 池 具                   for diaphragms and electrolyte solutions. Compared to traditional
           備更高能量密度（單位體積╱重量下存                               lithium-ion batteries, solid-state batteries offer higher energy density
           儲更多電能）、更快的充電速度、更長                               (storing more electric energy per unit volume/weight), faster charging
           的使用壽命以及更高的安全性（避免液                               speeds, longer service life, and increased safety (mitigating risks of
           態電解液洩漏、燃燒風險），但目前這                               liquid electrolyte leakage and combustion). However, this technology
           項 技 術 仍 面 臨 電 解 質 材 料 成 本 高、界                   currently faces challenges such as high costs of electrolyte materials,
           面 阻 抗 大、規 模 化 生 產 工 藝 不 成 熟 等                   high interface impedance, and immature large-scale production
           挑 戰，被 視 為 下 一 代 電 池 技 術 的 重 要                   processes. Solid-state batteries are considered a crucial direction for
           發展方向。                                           the development of the next generation of battery technology.

           的 目 標：激 勵 合 資 格 人 士 為 客 戶 及 股                   Eligible Persons to create value for customers and Shareholders,
           東創造價值及提高本公司的競爭力；                                and increase the Company’s competitiveness; to incentivise Eligible
           激勵合資格人士與本公司的發展戰略                                Persons to align the Company’s development strategy with theirs

           員 的 薪 酬 架 構，並 為 彼 等 提 供 一 個 可                   and provide them with a mechanism to own equity interests in the
           以 擁 有 本 公 司 股 權 的 機 制，以 分 享 利                   Company for interests and risks sharing; and (iv) to attract, motivate

      董事會多元化政策                                         Diversity Policy of the Board

      董事會已採納多元化政策，其中載有董事會                              The Board has adopted a diversity policy, which sets out the policy on
      多元化之方針。董事會持續不斷地尋求提高                              the diversity of the Board. The Board continuously seeks to enhance its
      其運作效率及保證最高水準的公司治理，並                              operation effectiveness and to maintain the highest standards of corporate
      且認識到董事會層面的多元化對於保持競爭                              governance and recognizes the vital importance of Board diversity for
      力及可續發展而言至關重要。在設計董事會                              maintaining competitive advantage and sustainable development. In
      組成時，本公司已從多方面考慮了董事會多                              designing the Board’s composition, the Company has considered the
      元化問題，包括但不限於性別、年齡、文化                              Board diversity from a number of perspectives, including but not limited
      和 教 育 背 景、專 業 經 驗、技 能、知 識、服 務                    to gender, age, culture and educational background, industry experience,
      期限長短及作為董事將需投入的時間等。                               skills, knowledge, length of services and time to be devoted as a Director.

      本公司還將不時考慮其自身業務模型和特殊                              The Company will also take into account its own business model and
      需要。最終決定將基於指定候選人可為董事                              special needs from time to time. The ultimate decision will be made based
      會帶來的貢獻及長處而做出。董事會力求確                              on the contribution and merit that the designated candidates will bring to
      保其具有均衡的技能、經驗及觀點多元化，                              the Board. The Board strives to ensure that it has the balance of skills,
      而這些均為董事會執行其商業戰略以及董事                              experience and diversity of perspectives that are required to support the
      會的有效運作所需。                                        execution of its business strategies and the effective operation of the Board.

意見                                Opinion

我們已審計列載於第198頁至375頁的江西贛            We have audited the consolidated financial statements of Ganfeng Lithium
鋒鋰業集團股份有限公司（「貴公司」）及其附             Group Co., Ltd. (the “Company”) and its subsidiaries (the “Group”) set
屬公司（統稱為「貴集團」）的綜合財務報表，             out on pages 198 to 375, which comprise the consolidated statement of
包括於2025年12月31日的綜合財務狀況表及           financial position as at 31 December 2025, and the consolidated statement
截至該日止年度的綜合損益表、綜合全面收               of profit or loss, the consolidated statement of comprehensive income, the
益表、綜合權益變動表及綜合現金流量表以               consolidated statement of changes in equity and the consolidated statement
及綜合財務報表附註，包括重大會計政策資               of cash flows for the year then ended, and notes to the consolidated
料。                                financial statements, including material accounting policy information.

我們認為，該等綜合財務報表已根據國際會               In our opinion, the consolidated financial statements give a true and fair
計準則理事會（「國際會計準則理事會」）頒佈             view of the consolidated financial position of the Group as at 31 December
的國際財務報告準則會計準則真實而中肯地               2025, and of its consolidated financial performance and its consolidated

                    公允價值計量                                        Fair value measurement

                     本集團在各報告期末，以公允價                               The Group measures its derivative financial instruments and
                     值計量其衍生金融工具及股權投                               equity investments at fair value at the end of each reporting
                     資。公允價值是指在計量日，市                               period. Fair value is the price that would be received to sell
                     場參與者在正常交易活動中銷售                               an asset or paid to transfer a liability in an orderly transaction
                     資產收到或者清償債務所支付的                               between market participants at the measurement date. The
                     金額。公允價值計量基於假設銷                               fair value measurement is based on the presumption that the
                     售資產或清償債務的交易發生於                               transaction to sell the asset or transfer the liability takes place
                     該資產或負債的主要市場，或者                               either in the principal market for the asset or liability, or in the
                     在缺失主要市場的情況下，發生                               absence of a principal market, in the most advantageous
                     於在最有利於該資產或負債的市                               market for the asset or liability. The principal or the most
                     場。主要市場或者最優市場必須                               advantageous market must be accessible by the Group.
                     是本集團可以參與的市場。資產                               The fair value of an asset or a liability is measured using the

                     與者在釐定資產或負債的定價時                               the asset or liability, assuming that market participants act in
                     所使用的假設計量，並假設市場                               their economic best interest.
                     參與者以其最佳經濟利益行事。

      50. 金融風險管理目標及政策                                      50. FINANCIAL RISK MANAGEMENT OBJECTIVES
                                                               AND POLICIES
             本集團的主要金融工具（衍生工具除外）                               The Group’s principal financial instruments, other than derivatives,
             包 括 銀 行 貸 款、應 付 債 券、其 他 計 息                      comprise bank loans, bonds payables, other interest-bearing loans,
             貸 款 及 現 金 及 短 期 存 款。該 等 金 融 工                    and cash and short-term deposits. The main purpose of these
             具的主要目的是為本集團的業務籌集                                 financial instruments is to raise finance for the Group’s operations.
             資 金。本 集 團 擁 有 多 項 其 他 金 融 資 產                    The Group has various other financial assets and liabilities such as
             及 負 債，例 如 貿 易 應 收 款 項、貿 易 應                      trade receivables, trade and bills payables, which arise directly from
             付 款 項 及 應 付 票 據，其 直 接 產 生 自 其                    its operations.
             經營業務。

             本 集 團 亦 訂 立 衍 生 工 具 交 易，主 要 包                    The Group also enters into derivative transactions, including principally
             括 利 率 掉 期、遠 期 貨 幣 合 約 及 期 權。                     interest rate swaps, forward currency contracts and options. The
             其目的是管理本集團營運及其融資來                                 purpose is to manage the interest rate and currency risks arising from
             源所產生的利率及貨幣風險。                                    the Group’s operations and its sources of finance.

             本集團金融工具產生的主要風險為利                                 The main risks arising from the Group’s financial instruments are
             率 風 險、外 匯 風 險、信 貸 風 險、流 動                        interest rate risk, foreign currency risk, credit risk, liquidity risk, equity
             性 風 險 風 險 及 權 益 價 格 風 險。董 事 會                    price risk. The board of directors reviews and agrees policies for

             政策載於財務報表附註2.4。                                   note 2.4 to the financial statements.

             利率風險                                             Interest rate risk

             本集團面臨的市場利率變動風險主要                                 The Group’s exposure to the risk of changes in market interest
             與本集團以浮動利率計息的長期債務                                 rates relates primarily to the Group’s long term debt obligations with
             責任有關。                                            floating interest rates.

             本集團的政策是使用固定及浮動利率                                 The Group’s policy is to manage its interest cost using a mix of fixed
             債務組合管理其利息成本。                                     and variable rate debts.
